description: Na₃CrSiCO₇ crystallizes in the monoclinic P2₁/m space group. There are two inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.33-2.85 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to seven O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.28-2.88 Å. Cr is bonded to six O atoms to form distorted CrO₆ octahedra that share corners with four equivalent SiO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Cr-O bond distances ranging from 1.96-2.17 Å. Si is bonded to four O atoms to form SiO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with four equivalent CrO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 36-47°. There are a spread of Si-O bond distances ranging from 1.63-1.66 Å. C is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to three O atoms. There is one shorter (1.28 Å) and two longer (1.31 Å) C-O bond lengths. There are six inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to four Na and one C atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to three Na, one Cr, and one C atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to three Na, one Cr, and one C atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Na, one Cr, and one Si atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a distorted tetrahedral geometry to two equivalent Na, one Cr, and one Si atom. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to three Na, one Cr, and one Si atom.
